items.note: An empty list now draws an empty strip. I logged that call in `docs/unruled.md`: an empty list is treated as not loaded yet, so there is no throw and no warning.

items.claim: Previewing `onRangeInput` shrinks the axis under an inward edge drag
Home/End on a range end do nothing and `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax` can't be reached
items.note: A range end now stops one key step (1% of the track) short of the other end when no locked band holds the range open. That applies to drags as well as keys. I logged the call in `docs/unruled.md`. The existing value-triple test now expects 99 and 1 where it had 100 and 0.

items.claim: Range end ignores PageUp/PageDown, and `KEY_STEP` is defined twice
Edge drag can't snap to ticks outside the range
A split band takes the first tagged band's tag, and the payload lookup goes wrong when bands share a payload
Rescale sends untouched seams through track units and back, so they drift
Range edge's ARIA bound can't be reached and Home/End does nothing
